title: Project
description: Root project configuration. Read first by the compiler to locate all other assets.

project_id.description: Immutable slug identifier. Lowercase, hyphens only. Do not change after production begins.

version.description: Semantic version of the project configuration.

compiler_version.description: The compiler version this project targets. The compiler will reject projects whose constraint it does not satisfy.

style.description: Path to style.yaml, relative to project root.

characters_dir.description: Path to characters directory, relative to project root.

environments_dir.description: Path to environments directory, relative to project root.

layouts_dir.description: Path to layouts directory, relative to project root.

chapters_dir.description: Path to chapters directory, relative to project root.

output_dir.description: Path to output directory, relative to project root. Application writes here; humans do not edit here.

image_generation.description: Image generation backend configuration. See DESIGN.md §10.

backend.description: Adapter identifier. The active backend is specified here, not hardcoded.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the backend API.

quality.description: Generation quality level. Maps to API quality parameter.

reference_budget.description: Max reference images per panel. API maximum is 16. Default 8.

thinking.description: Controls how much the model reasons about the prompt before rendering. Default: medium.

seed.description: int32 for loose reproducibility, or null for random each time. Default: null.

scene_prompt.description: Scene Prompt Generator configuration. See DESIGN.md §9.

model.description: LLM model used for scene prompt generation.

context_profile.description: Versioned context profile identifier. Changing this changes what inputs are passed to the LLM.

threshold.description: Composite score required for acceptance. Below this, regeneration is triggered.

weights.description: Weights for composite score calculation. Must sum to 1.0.

max_regeneration_attempts.description: Maximum automatic regeneration attempts before escalating to human review.

assets_source.description: Path to external reference image storage. Relative to project root or absolute. Used by scripts/sync_assets.py. Optional — can also be passed via --source flag.

pipeline_mode.description: Selects the producer+parser pair (chapter-plan path or scene path). Shared downstream never branches on it. See DESIGN.md §16.9.

scenes_dir.description: Path to scene plan directory (scene mode), relative to project root.

templates_dir.description: Path to template registry directory (scene mode), relative to project root.

bleed_px.description: Bleed per edge. Usable area = page - 2x bleed.

gutter_px.description: Default gutter between panels, strips, and elements.

scene_inputs_dir.description: Path to scene producer input files (scene mode), relative to project root.
